body: Released core 1.0.1 (c97418d) and self-hosted it (877df5e): gate verdict can no longer be cleared by a piped consumer (sh: pipefail where supported, top-level pipelines rejected otherwise; ps1: parser audit — at most one external stage per pipeline, verdict = exit code OR $?); ledger-sync verify now parse-checks every port (ParseFile over bin/*.ps1, sh -n over sh ports); package suite tests/run-tests.sh green 11/11 across both editions. Suite + verify evidence: 'core OK: every file matches MANIFEST.sha256 and every port parses (1.0.1)'. Scope released exactly as claimed; encoding fixes remain Kai's 1.0.2.
